correctness.rationale: The exact periodic Green kernel gives a piecewise-linear translate difference with amplitude d(2pi-d)/(4pi), whose maximum over 0<=d<=pi is pi/4. This proves osc(w)<=pi/4 ||e-e_bar||_1. Shifting w by its minimum places the lower function inside [A,B], after which the focal multiplicity proof applies unchanged. The packaged checker replays the branch identities; finite computation is not used as proof.
